attributes.title: 2027 West River Continuing Education Meeting
attributes.summary:
A one-day CE meeting in Rapid City, convenient for practitioners in western South Dakota. The 2027 meeting is on Saturday, January 30, 2027, from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. at the Clubhouse Hotel & Suites, on the theme "Feline and Canine Dermatology".

The association lists 8 hours of continuing education; the page does not state RACE approval. Advanced registration through January 15, 2027, costs $175 for members and veterinary technicians and $225 for non-members; late and on-site registration is $200 and $250. The meeting is not livestreamed, but a recording is made available to registered attendees afterwards. Rooms at the hotel are $129 plus tax per night, and attendees book their own.
